simba.Codes.Cheetah.Cheetah module

SIMBA Cheetah Module

Various objects and functions to handle Cheetah lattices and commands. See Cheetah github for more details.

Classes:

  • cheetahLattice: The Cheetah lattice object, used for converting the frameworkObject s defined in the frameworkLattice into a Cheetah lattice object, and for tracking through it.
